commands.help: Enumerate network sessions with client hostname resolution (BOFHound compatible)
commands.long_help: Extended version of get-netsession that resolves client IP addresses to hostnames. Uses NetSessionEnum to list sessions with additional hostname resolution via DNS PTR lookup or NetWkstaGetInfo. Outputs computer name and domain for BloodHound/BOFHound ingestion.

arguments.name: hostname
arguments.desc: Target computer to query for sessions (default: local system)

arguments.name: method
arguments.desc: Resolution method for client IPs: 1 = DNS PTR lookup (default), any other value = NetWkstaGetInfo

arguments.name: dnsserver
arguments.desc: DNS server IP address for PTR lookups (only used with method=1). Omit to use system default DNS.
